subject: Blueleaf MAP + implementation gameplan
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Nora Patel <nora.patel@blueleaf.ai>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-08-30T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Draft MAP: Blueleaf onboarding & first 8 weeks

Nora — attaching a first-pass mutual action plan for the Blueleaf rollout. High-level notes:

- Goal: 80% of production traffic on Redwood inference path by end of week 8.
- Primary milestones: provisioning, API integration, QA + performance tuning, pilot launch, go-live.
- Owners are proposed next to each milestone; please flag any gaps.

Attachments: Blueleaf_MAP_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet)

Ask: can you review ownership sections and confirm the preferred go-live week? We put a tentative go-live in week 8 (w/c Sep 21) but open to moving that to week 7 or 9 depending on integration velocity.

Proposed kickoff: Mon, Sep 6 — 30 minute alignment + runbook review. If that works I can lock a calendar invite.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0147

[Attachment: Blueleaf_MAP_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet)]

From: Nora Patel <nora.patel@blueleaf.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-08-31T14:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Draft MAP: Blueleaf onboarding & first 8 weeks

Thanks Marissa — this looks good and very actionable. A few quick points from our side:

- Could we add an Integration Owner on our side? I’ll nominate Priya (eng@blueleaf.ai) as the main contact for API work.
- The proposed week 8 go-live is tight for us given an internal security review scheduled the week of Sep 14. Would prefer targeting week 9 (w/c Sep 28) to give a buffer.
- We need a short checkbox for SOC/PII proof points in the runbook (data retention, audit logs).

I’m happy with the kickoff on Sep 6 — please send an invite.

Nora
Director of Platform Engineering
Blueleaf AI
nora.patel@blueleaf.ai

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: Nora Patel <nora.patel@blueleaf.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-08-31T16:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Draft MAP: Blueleaf onboarding & first 8 weeks

Looping in a slightly more prescriptive runbook and owner breakdown based on Nora's asks. Key updates:

- Go-live: move to week 9 (w/c Sep 28) to accommodate Blueleaf security review.
- Blueleaf Integration Owner: Priya (eng@blueleaf.ai) — please add contact info and calendar availability.
- Redwood owners:
  * Provisioning & infra access — Ben Carter (account ops)
  * API integration & end-to-end tests — Jonas Weber (eng lead) + devs on eng@blueleaf.ai
  * Performance tuning & KV/cache strategy — Redwood runtime team (coordinator: Jonas)
  * Security evidence & audit list — Marissa to coordinate legal/sales discovery with Blueleaf SOC owner

Week-by-week checkpoints (compact):
- Week 0 (Sep 6): Kickoff (alignment, runbook walkthrough)
- Week 1: Provisioning + API keys + narrow QA dataset
- Week 2: Integration tests + perf baseline collection
- Week 3: First pilot (small traffic slice) + fixes
- Weeks 4–6: Iterate on perf, quantization suggestions, caching profiles
- Week 7: Pilot ramp / pre-prod validation
- Week 9: Go-live (full traffic switch)

Attachments: integration-checklist.pdf (pdf) — includes acceptance criteria and test cases.

Next steps for internal ops: Ben, can you confirm provisioning SLA and whether we need any MSA addendum for customer-managed keys? Marissa, I put a short SOC evidence checklist in the drive link — please confirm we have the artifacts Blueleaf needs.

Jonas
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com

[Attachment: integration-checklist.pdf (pdf)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Nora Patel <nora.patel@blueleaf.ai>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-09-01T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Draft MAP: Blueleaf onboarding & first 8 weeks — confirmed schedule and kickoff

Great — thanks Nora and Jonas. Quick summary and asks so we have a single source of truth before kickoff: 

Agreed changes:
- Go-live week: w/c Sep 28 (week 9)
- Blueleaf Integration Owner: Priya (eng@blueleaf.ai) — Nora to add to thread or forward contact vCard.
- SOC/PII checklist: added to runbook in Drive (link below).

Committed deliverables before kickoff (Sep 6):
1) Blueleaf: confirm Priya contact + any blackout dates for Sep 6–10.
2) Redwood (Ben): environment provisioning request completed (access + API keys) by Sep 3.
3) Redwood (Jonas): integration-checklist + test harness link shared by Sep 3.
4) Marissa: will compile SOC evidence checklist and share a short packet via Drive by EOD Sep 2.

Please confirm the three commits above by EOD Sep 2 so we can lock the kickoff and calendar invites. I’ll schedule a 30-minute kickoff for Sep 6 at 10:00 PT unless someone suggests a different time.

HubSpot deal: RF-2026-1287 (I updated the MAP link and milestones in the record)
Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB_example_MAP

Thanks all — looking forward to kickoff.

—
Marissa Cole
